description: The owner's FlexiHAL router as a machine, and a setup on it. X, Y and Z are from the controller's settings (2026-11-08): travel $130-$132 is 672, 1023 and 160 mm; homing ($23=2) runs X and Z to their plus ends and Y to its minus end, and without a forced origin machine space is minus the travel to 0. A is an estimate until the new A axis is mounted: it turns about X on the table, continuously, its centre 300 mm from the Y home (Y -723) and 40 mm above the table; the table is at Z -138.08, read with the tip of an unrecorded tool on it, so it is off by that tool's length; positive A is clockwise seen from X+, so it turns about -X. The post is grblHAL.
